```{=html}
<div class="ast-anim" id="astAnim">
  <style>
        .ast-anim {
        font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, sans-serif;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e2e2e2);
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 1rem;
        margin: 1rem 0 1.6rem;
        display: flex;
        gap: 1.4rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        /* depth palette, restepped for dark below */
        --d0: #2a78d6;
        --d1: #eb6834;
        --d2: #1baf7a;
        --d3: #eda100;
        --d4: #e87ba4;
        }

        @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
            .ast-anim {
                --d0: #3987e5;
                --d1: #d95926;
                --d2: #199e70;
                --d3: #c98500;
                --d4: #d55181;
            }
        }

        .ast-anim pre.code {
            margin: 0;
            font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
            font-size: .82rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .ast-anim .ln {
            display: block;
            padding: .1rem .6rem .1rem .5rem;
            cursor: default;
            border-left: 3px solid transparent;
            border-radius: 2px;
            color: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
            white-space: pre;
        }

        .ast-anim .legend {
            flex-basis: 100%;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: .75rem;
            color: var(--muted, #666);
        }

        .ast-anim .legend span {
            display: inline-block;
            margin: 0 .5rem;
        }

        .ast-anim .legend i {
            display: inline-block;
            width: .65em;
            height: .65em;
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin-right: .3em;
        }

        .ast-anim svg text {
            font-size: 12px;
            fill: var(--fg, #1a1a1a);
        }

        .ast-anim svg .edge {
            stroke: var(--rule, #999);
            stroke-width: 1.5;
        }

        .ast-anim .node circle {
            stroke: none;
        }

        .ast-anim .ln,
        .ast-anim .node,
        .ast-anim .edge {
            transition: opacity .15s;
        }

        .ast-anim.focus .ln,
        .ast-anim.focus .node,
        .ast-anim.focus .edge {
            opacity: .3;
        }

        .ast-anim.focus .ln.hl,
        .ast-anim.focus .node.hl,
        .ast-anim.focus .edge.hl {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .ast-anim .ln.hl {
            background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rule, #e2e2e2) 45%, transparent);
        }
  </style>
 
  <pre class="code" aria-label="python example">

<span class="ln" data-n="module"><span style="color:var(--muted,#666)"># module 1 depth 0</span></span>
<span class="ln" data-n="def" style="border-color:var(--d1)">def norm(vec):</span>
<span class="ln" data-n="assign" style="border-color:var(--d2)">    total = 0</span>
<span class="ln" data-n="for" style="border-color:var(--d2)">    for x in vec:</span>
<span class="ln" data-n="if" style="border-color:var(--d3)">        if x != 0:</span>
<span class="ln" data-n="aug" style="border-color:var(--d4)">            total += x * x</span>
<span class="ln" data-n="ret" style="border-color:var(--d2)">    return sqrt(total)</span></pre>
 
  <svg viewBox="0 0 460 300" width="430" role="img" aria-label="syntax tree of the example">
    <g id="astEdges"></g><g id="astNodes"></g>
  </svg>
 
  <div class="legend" id="astLegend"></div>
 
  <script>
    (function () {
        var root = document.getElementById("astAnim");
        
        var NODES = [
            ["module", "module", 0, 230, 28, null],
            ["def", "def norm", 1, 230, 88, "module"],
            ["assign", "total = 0", 2, 80, 152, "def"],
            ["for", "for x in vec", 2, 230, 152, "def"],
            ["ret", "return", 2, 380, 152, "def"],
            ["if", "if x != 0", 3, 230, 216, "for"],
            ["sqrt", "sqrt(total)", 3, 380, 216, "ret"],
            ["aug", "total += x*x", 4, 230, 280, "if"]
        ];

        var byName = {}, kids = {};
        NODES.forEach(function (n) { byName[n[0]] = n; kids[n[0]] = []; });
        NODES.forEach(function (n) { if (n[5]) kids[n[5]].push(n[0]); });
        
        var lineOf = { sqrt: "ret" };

        var svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
        var gE = document.getElementById("astEdges"),
            gN = document.getElementById("astNodes");
        NODES.forEach(function (n) {
            if (n[5]) {
                var p = byName[n[5]], e = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
                e.setAttribute("x1", p[3]); e.setAttribute("y1", p[4] + 9);
                e.setAttribute("x2", n[3]); e.setAttribute("y2", n[4] - 9);
                e.setAttribute("class", "edge"); e.setAttribute("data-to", n[0]);
                gE.appendChild(e);
            }
            var g = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "g");
            g.setAttribute("class", "node"); g.setAttribute("data-n", n[0]);
            var c = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
            c.setAttribute("cx", n[3]); c.setAttribute("cy", n[4]); c.setAttribute("r", 8);
            c.setAttribute("fill", "var(--d" + n[2] + ")");
            var t = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
            t.setAttribute("x", n[3] + 13); t.setAttribute("y", n[4] + 4);
            if (n[0] === "ret" || n[0] === "sqrt") {           
                t.setAttribute("x", n[3] - 13); t.setAttribute("text-anchor", "end");
            }
            t.textContent = n[1];
            g.appendChild(c); g.appendChild(t); gN.appendChild(g);
        });

        var legend = document.getElementById("astLegend");
        for (var d = 0; d <= 4; d++)
            legend.innerHTML += "<span><i style='background:var(--d" + d + ")'></i>depth " + d + "</span>";

        function ancestors(name) {
            var out = [];
            while (name) { out.push(name); name = byName[name][5]; }
            return out;
        }
        function subtree(name) {
            var out = [name];
            kids[name].forEach(function (k) { out = out.concat(subtree(k)); });
            return out;
        }
        function highlight(name) {
            var set = {};
            ancestors(name).forEach(function (m) { set[m] = 1; });
            subtree(name).forEach(function (m) { set[m] = 1; });
            root.classList.add("focus");
            root.querySelectorAll(".node, .ln").forEach(function (el) {
                var m = el.getAttribute("data-n");
                el.classList.toggle("hl", !!set[m] || !!set[lineOf[m]]);
            });
            root.querySelectorAll(".edge").forEach(function (el) {
                el.classList.toggle("hl", !!set[el.getAttribute("data-to")]);
            });
        }
        function clear() {
            root.classList.remove("focus");
            root.querySelectorAll(".hl").forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove("hl"); });
        }
        root.querySelectorAll(".ln, .node").forEach(function (el) {
            el.addEventListener("pointerenter", function () { highlight(el.getAttribute("data-n")); });
            el.addEventListener("pointerleave", clear);
        });
        })();
  </script>
</div>
```
